# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.0-alpha.1-internal.1897 (loopback protocol check)
name: "Gemini Decisions accessibility routing"
version: "1.0"
agents: []
orchestrator:
  name: decision
  strategy: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: classify
        type: decision
        decision:
          backend: gemini
          input: {from: query}
          questions:
            queue:
              type: choice
              instructions: "Which accessibility review queue owns this issue?"
              choices:
                keyboard: "Keyboard interaction or focus order"
                labels: "Screen reader names or labels"
                visual: "Contrast or visual presentation"
